parsed.why: Most-protective tier: no facility ban, public-accommodations and hate-crime coverage, shield law, X-marker documents, working institutions. National passport/entry regime still applies, capping it below low-risk.

Criminalises restroom use across private businesses — gas stations, restaurants, hospitals — universal exposure under parent's hostile regime; only pending litigation as remedy, penalties steeper than comparable laws.

Top Do-Not-Travel tier: birth-certificate facility rule, documented trooper ID checks, active DOJ enforcement inquiry, court-upheld prison care denial, gender-identity excluded from hate-crime law. Hostile state actively enforcing.

Executive order applies birth sex to all state facilities, shelters and incarceration; documents closed retroactively, adult public-facility care barred, no discrimination or hate-crime cover. No documented visitor enforcement, but structurally among the strictest.

Facility ban repealed 2017, no criminalisation, no statewide facility restriction. Offset by narrowed amended documents, no statewide non-discrimination, no hate-crime cover, revived bathroom bills, and parent's passport regime.
